text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r r-u-n a-u-t-o-m-a-t-e-d a-t-t-e-m-p-t-s a-g-a-i-n-s-t l-o-y-a-l-t-y a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s a-n-d g-i-f-t c-a-r-d b-a-l-a-n-c-e-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g s-c-r-i-p-t l-o-g-s a-s a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t-s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g a-c-c-e-s-s a-u-d-i-t-s.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r s-w-o-r-e p-s-w-o-r-d-s a-n-d t-o-k-e-n-s t-o t-a-k-e o-v-e-r a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g c-h-a-n-g-e-d l-o-g-i-n r-e-c-o-r-d-s a-s a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t-s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-w-o-f-a-c-t-o-r v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-o-n-v-e-r-t-e-d b-a-l-a-n-c-e-s i-n-t-o c-a-s-h o-r g-o-o-d-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g t-r-a-n-s-a-c-t-i-o-n h-i-s-t-o-r-i-e-s a-s a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t-s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g f-r-a-u-d r-u-l-e r-e-v-i-e-w-s.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-i-s-p-e-r-s-e-d p-u-r-c-h-a-s-e-s o-v-e-r t-i-m-e a-n-d v-a-l-u-e-s t-o m-i-m-i-c n-o-r-m-a-l s-h-o-p-p-i-n-g, l-e-a-v-i-n-g o-r-d-e-r s-e-q-u-e-n-c-e-s a-s a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t-s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g b-e-h-a-v-i-o-r a-n-a-l-y-s-i-s.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-l-e-a-r-e-d t-r-a-c-e d-a-t-a a-f-t-e-r e-a-c-h s-t-e-p, l-e-a-v-i-n-g r-e-s-i-d-u-a-l n-e-t-w-o-r-k m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a a-s a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t-s, w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g i-n-c-i-d-e-n-t n-o-t-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
